learning_outcomes.text: Describe the layers of the Earth and their properties
Explain plate tectonics and the evidence for moving plates
Relate plate boundaries to earthquakes and volcanoes
Describe how different volcano types form and erupt
Explain how magma, lava and igneous rock are linked
Interpret a simple hazard map for a volcanic region

integrative_case: A town sits near a composite volcano on a convergent boundary: a student team explains the plate setting, compares past gentle and explosive eruptions, interprets the hazard map for lava, ash and lahars, and writes advice on monitoring signs and evacuation.
